messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Kaushik S

kaushik... that's a name that means "skilled" in sanskrit. your parents had high expectations.

where you working these days?
Bangalore

nah kaushik, i meant which company... not the city. everyone's in bangalore.

where do you work? which company?
SAP

sap... the enterprise software giant where dreams go to get implemented in 18-month cycles.

found you on linkedin - kaushik s, sap certified mdg consultant. this you? https://www.linkedin.com/in/kaushiksannidanam90
No
Alumini of PSGTech and have did summer intern with SAP, won SIH 2022

https://www.linkedin.com/in/kaushiksss?utm_source=share_via&utm_content=profile&utm_medium=member_android

Tell me if this is accessible?

psgtech to sap... that's a solid trajectory from the premier engineering college to enterprise software. sih 2022 winner too - building solutions that actually matter. respect.

what made you stick with sap after the internship? most people bounce after getting the brand name on their resume.

I stayed because the internship didn’t feel like a checkbox. I had real ownership, real systems to influence, and mentors who treated me like someone expected to contribute, not observe. The scale of SAP’s landscape kept me curious, and the work felt worth the effort. Leaving just for a shinier logo never made sense, I like to be in places where I can actually experiment and try new things.
Since July 2024

so you're about 1.5 years in... still fresh but with some real experience under your belt. 

what kind of role you looking for next?
how long you been working total?

Developer/Machine learning engineers/Devops 
I am in touch with all three

dev, ml, devops... that's the full stack trifecta. rare to see someone actually skilled across all three instead of just claiming it on their resume.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Open for every new experience
Yeah
1.5 years + dev/ml/devops + open to everything... sound right?

welcome to the tal network legend 🔥

you're officially in the system. roles that match your dev/ml/devops skillset will start flowing your way. the good ones. the ones that actually pay.

your profile screams "substance over hype" and honestly? that's exactly what the smart companies are hunting for right now. someone who can code, deploy, AND understand the math behind the magic.

buckle up kaushik. about to show you what 1.5 years of real experience is actually worth in this market.

hey, infosys has a python ml dev role in bengaluru

they're looking for someone with your exact dev/ml/devops stack - python, sql, docker, kubernetes, aws

the jd mentions 4+ years but the field says 0-1 years, so might be worth checking what they actually need
